user.title: MyFox account
user.description: Create a Personal application on https://api.myfox.me/dev/apps, then enter CLIENT_ID, CLIENT_SECRET, the MyFox email (MYFOX_USER) and the MyFox password (MYFOX_PSWD).

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect MyFox
reauth_confirm.description: The MyFox connection for {name} expired. Enter CLIENT_ID, CLIENT_SECRET, MYFOX_USER and MYFOX_PSWD again.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the MyFox API.
error.no_site: No site was found for this MyFox account.
error.unknown: Unexpected error while signing in to MyFox.
